original_value: This editorial introduces the special issue on marketing science and health. We begin by describing the healthcare ecosystem and its many distinguishing features relative to other markets. With its large share of U.S. and world gross domestic product; rapid changes on the demand, supply, and regulatory sides; and a complex ecosystem with many types of participants, healthcare markets provide a rich canvas of novel research opportunities for marketing scholars. We then describe the special issue process and the papers published in the special issue. We summarize key themes that emerge from these papers and conclude with a discussion of future research opportunities in the area.

result.paraphrase: This editorial introduces the special issue on marketing science and health. It starts with an overview of the healthcare ecosystem and the many ways it differs from other markets. Because healthcare accounts for a large share of U.S. and global GDP, is rapidly changing on the demand, supply, and regulatory fronts, and involves a complex network of many kinds of participants, it offers marketing scholars a rich setting for new research. The editorial then outlines the special issue process and the papers included in the issue, summarizes the main themes emerging from them, and closes by discussing future research opportunities in this area.
